[image: Ending the 100-Mile Constitution-Free Zone illustration] Ending the 100-Mile Constitution-Free Zone Repeal the inland 100-mile extension that lets the government search two-thirds of the country without a warrant. Inspection stays at the actual border, not 100 miles past it. Read More
[image: Expanding Fiber Optic Access for All illustration] Expanding Fiber Optic Access for All Unchain Michigan’s future with federal investment in fiber optic broadband for all. Read More

[image: Human Control Over Lethal Force illustration] Human Control Over Lethal Force No autonomous system should decide to kill without a human who answers for it. Lydia will require human authorization for AI-directed lethal force in every DoD contract and stop agencies from retaliating against contractors who refuse to remove those safeguards. Read More

[image: Repealing the Patriot Act: Defending Civil Liberties illustration] Repealing the Patriot Act: Defending Civil Liberties Most of the Patriot Act's surveillance powers already expired in 2020. Two provisions are still active: sneak-and-peek warrants that delay notifying you of a search, and National Security Letters that compel your records without a judge's approval. Lydia will push to end both. Read More

[image: Restoring Net Neutrality illustration] Restoring Net Neutrality Your internet provider can currently block websites, slow them down, or sell fast lanes, deciding what you can see and say online, and Michigan has no law stopping it. Past net neutrality bills failed because they imported outdated telephone-monopoly regulation and one-party support. Lydia will introduce a federal law that bans those three practices directly, applies to mobile internet, and gives people a real way to enforce it. Read More
